decisions_log.why: The cascade demands she corrupt herself first; the register says cold/deliberate/conquest-not-longing. The two pull against each other and THAT TENSION IS HER ARC. A pure tool-user has no arc (she is already who she'll be — a still-point shape in a game not built for it); a genuine fall loses the cold predator the seed promised. The resolution: THE COLD IS ARMOR, NOT THE CHARACTER. What cracks it is the ONE THING SHE DOESN'T CONTROL — the forced/prey-early liberties (a guest's hand, Grayson in her doorway) — which is precisely what a woman who thinks she's holding the weapon cannot account for. Bootstrap: night one she gets herself off in the bed she was a child in, out of SPITE, not appetite.

decisions_log.decision: Richard's brief LOCKED. CONTRADICTION FOUND AND RESOLVED: v1's brief bans the 'dead-wife angle' ('Catherine never impersonates or evokes Eleanor'), but Step 2's pregnancy declaration framed his child as 'you REPLACE ELEANOR in the house'. Resolution: IMPERSONATION IS BANNED (method) / SUPPLANTING IS THE POINT (outcome). She never wears the dead woman or uses the ghost as bait — that would make him a mark being conned, and it's cheap. She takes Eleanor's place BY BEING BETTER AT IT, and the child is the seal. She did not become Eleanor; she ENDED her.
decisions_log.why: Surfaced rather than silently picked, per the don't-be-naive rule. ALSO: Richard is where the player's armor THINS. Everyone else is a transaction she executes cleanly; he is the one where the technique doesn't entirely stay technique — she sits with him because it works, then sits a little longer than it works, and never admits it. He genuinely falls; she takes everything anyway. That is not romance — it is the horror of finding out you're capable of meaning it and doing it regardless. It ties his arc directly to the Pass-1 player crack ('she uses it, then she wants it') and is what earns the seed's 'heaviest tonal outlier — handle with care' note.

decisions_log.decision: Margaret's brief LOCKED, with NEW STORY. Kept from v1: destroyed NOT seduced (no romantic yielding, ever), untouchable until everything else is taken, formidable to the end, the breaking is ONE-AND-DONE (her own two pillars turned against her), terminal = the household's communal slave working the vice floor she schemed to own.
decisions_log.why: THE REAL ROOT CAUSE, FOUND: v1 did not under-build her — her STORY had no climb in it. v1's Margaret arc was 'cold war -> cornering -> breaking -> slavery' = FOUR BIG NIGHTS AND SOME SPARRING, with no rungs between. She was cast antagonist (6-10) BECAUSE the writing genuinely had nothing else in it; the shape matched the story and the STORY was the bug. So re-shaping her to DENSE was not a budget edit — it demanded new story. THE NEW STORY: her weapon was always 'she banks your missteps — she FILES, she doesn't grope' (v1 wrote that line and never built it). That IS the arc. Act 1 she CATCHES you and says nothing (each catch a scene; the noose tightens — this is Step 2's status pressure made concrete). Act 2 she SPENDS what she banked (each file becomes a move; each move a scene where you LOSE ground and claw it back). THE TURN: she watches too long, once — she despises what you're doing and cannot stop looking. Never yields, never admits — but it makes the breaking WORSE, because you will eventually give her by force the thing she'd never have admitted she wanted.
